I changed the [Orchestrator skill](../execution/roles/orchestrator/SKILL.md) to require saved independent expectations before the checker reads the proposed key.
Review #567 read key expectations first; its independent derivation therefore remains unverified. [Evidence](history/sessions/567/177b3cbe659030ee2bdbcad701753acd64d8373e425f1798dd14d294da002b95.md)

Fallback can still mix model families; the next Policymaker must check the actual candidates.
I added report-status instructions to the [Reviewer skill](../execution/roles/reviewer/SKILL.md) to prevent rejected Finish calls.
YAML parsing and route assertions passed. The approved three-iteration cadence stays unchanged.
[Policy working memory](../policy/working-memory.md) records the evidence, decisions and expected effects. [Policy orders](orders.json) contain no tasks.

## Discoveries

Iterations 0115–0116 recorded 17 limit hits and 8,719 parked seconds; provider limits overlapped. [Records](history/manifest.json)
The engine rejected an edit of `execution/protocol.md` as outside accepted paths; role-skill edits succeeded. [Details](../policy/working-memory.md)

## What next

The Orchestrator must correct findings F1/F2, then order a new review that saves independent expectations before reading the key.
Preserve #567's exact review evidence through a permitted writer; do not repeat historical probes.
The next Policymaker must check derivation order, reviewer candidates and Finish errors against these changes.
Native results and artifact/version coverage remain incomplete. Product quality is unmeasured; method acceptance and the Goal gate remain pending.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
